name: SPAM
source:
In this visual novel you will meet Mira Kalinina, an ordinary teenager trying to remain a child in a hurricane of crazy days. After all the choices she has to make, will she be able to live as before? In this visual novel you will have to face difficult choices, solve many mysteries, and find adventures out of the blue.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ru.redsnail.spam_censor]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
在这部视觉小说中，你将遇到米拉·卡利尼娜 (Mira Kalinina)，她是一名普通青少年，在疯狂的飓风日子里努力保持孩子的样子。做出种种选择后，她还能像以前一样生活吗？在这部视觉小说中，你将不得不面对艰难的选择，解开许多谜团，并发现意想不到的冒险。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ru.redsnail.spam_censor]Google Play[/url]]
